proposal.principle: Shiori is a reader-first personal guide, not an ad feed. A8 placement is never a requirement to recommend an article.
proposal.slot_policy: Replace no more than two Wed/Sat 20:00 everyday posts per week with a verified, curated older article, AFTER the pinned Oct 14/17/21/24 calendar is over. Do not add new posts at other hours; keep 22:00 same-day introductions independently gated.
eligibility: Published WordPress article only; canonical URL matches HTTPS host and article slug
Do not link future/draft post; do not trust the queued plan without live verification
Dedupe across article-id and date slot using existing state/threads-ledger; read whether article was already introduced before selecting candidates
No repeated article introduction in <=30 days; do not link the same article at 20:00 and 22:00
No made-up product use, product outcomes or purchase endorsement in Shiori's first person
Use 【PR】 on posts linking to articles with affiliate promotions and ensure article's own disclosures remain visible
Recommend some genuinely ad-free editorial content as well; do not favor commission alone
Rate cap: do not automatically substitute every 20:00 daily persona post; if no fresh eligible item, post ordinary Shiori everyday copy
proposal.lookback_basis: One evergreen candidate a few days or weeks old, aligned with common daily frustrations and a distinct topic across successive slots.
